hard_constraints.x1: Global traffic stays live and each tenant write pause is at most 30 seconds.
hard_constraints.x2: Exactly one store is authoritative before and after the atomic route change.
hard_constraints.x3: Copying is resumable and idempotent from a durable tenant checkpoint.
hard_constraints.x4: Cutover is a compare-and-swap guarded by high-watermark and verification evidence.

unresolved_work.w1: Determine whether the decision and dependency plan preserve authority through cutover and recovery.

current_responsibility: Independently review the candidate tenant-store migration decision and cutover plan.
